## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` and `npm run build` pass

For a showroom card:

- [ ] `showroom/<card>/` contains `card.html`, `screenshot.png` and `README.md`
- [ ] The card is listed in `showroom/README.md`
- [ ] Placeholder entities only: no tokens, passwords or private addresses
- [ ] The screenshot shows no private details
- [ ] I agree to publish the card under the MIT License
